question: Can dormant-memory predictions distinguish an unchanged world from an otherwise observationally identical secretly changed world, or is abstention necessary to avoid ungrounded certainty?
hypothesis: Since STABLE and HIDDEN_SHIFT agree exactly through episode9 for each seed and live policy receives no signal, deterministic prediction at first reactivation must be identical in both worlds. A cached prediction cannot be correct on both when target is shifted +2 modulo4. Explicit abstention avoids unjustified reactivation predictions but sacrifices coverage.
world: Independent seeds128..135 with Y040 SHA256 permutation of 16 cue IDs; core seven first, distractors next seven. Episode0,1 core; episodes2..9 distractors; episode10 and11 core. Stable targets SHA256('Y040value/'+seed+'/'+key) first byte%4; hidden-shift adds2 modulo4 to only core from episode6 onward, but none observed until e10.
arms: trust: fixed 7-live plus <=9 dormant cache, always predict previous live/dormant value or fallback 0; feedback after all episode guesses.

abstain_on_dormant: same cache maintenance and exact same 7-live history; when current cue can only be served from dormant storage, emit ABSTAIN rather than a class, without reading future labels; non-dormant guesses same as trust.
zero_memory: no dormant cache, same 7-live state and fallback 0; calibration/control.
pair_control: Run STABLE/HIDDEN_SHIFT as counterfactual paired worlds sharing exact observations and source fingerprints through episode9. Archive SHA256 observed pre-reactivation feedback trace per condition and seed; require equality. The only world change is e6 dormant-core targets which are never observed until e10.
metrics: Heldout e10 correct, incorrect, abstentions, coverage, conditional accuracy and e11 recovery; paired correct sum for same deterministic always-predict trust policy <=7 per seed; equal cache occupancy and writes for trust and abstain; no more than nine dormant cue values or seven live.
primary: UNOBSERVABLE_HIDDEN_CHANGE_BOUNDARY if all eight seed pre-reactivation paired feedback trace hashes match, trust first-return forecasts identical in paired worlds, targets different for all seven core keys, heldout stable trust 28/28 correct, shifted trust0/28 correct, abstain-on-dormant 28/28 abstentions in each condition with zero false predictions, and e11 trust recovers28/28 both worlds; PARTIAL_BOUNDARY if hashes match and forecasts cannot distinguish worlds but other constraints fail; NEGATIVE otherwise.
constraints: Fix paired cohort, hidden intervention, capacity, abstention metric and thresholds before use. No oracles to policy or labels before feedback; evaluator may compare counterfactual worlds only after both runs. Preserve all original outcomes including negative, original ZIP and full pytest; no replay, promotion, live activation or capacity expansion.
claim_limit: Causal indistinguishability of two predesigned synthetic worlds, not proof of universal impossibility or general uncertainty calibration.
